LESSON: POPULATION STRUCTURE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.4: Population Structure

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Population Structure
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is the population structure of a country important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify sources of population data in a country
2. explain factors determining population structure in Kenya and Germany
3. construct age-sex population pyramids of developed and developing countries

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
